title: Volcano Garden Arts
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Volcano Garden Arts is situated on a World Heritage site a mile from Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park. Once a part of the 1908 Hopper Estate, its lovely grounds include enchanting cultivated gardens, art studios, greenhouses for both plant cultivation and art-making, and access to nature trails into surrounding, upland rain forest.
hoursText: Open Every Day (except Wednesday) 10:00 am to 4:00 pm
